data_sources: Real-time measurements from the manufacturing period

additional_info.simulation_requirements: Run for at least 432000 s (60 hours)

modules.name: Sensor Data Collector
modules.description: Collects real-time sensor data from manufacturing equipment

modules.name: Input Stream Reader
modules.description: Reads input stream data for part arrival intervals

analytics_engine.name: Analytics Engine
analytics_engine.description: Processes and analyzes collected data to generate KPIs and insights

models.name: Predictive Maintenance Model
models.description: Predicts equipment failures based on machine availability and downtime data

models.name: Energy Consumption Optimizer
models.description: Optimizes energy consumption per part based on work and idle power data

dashboard.name: Digital Twin Dashboard
dashboard.description: Real-time visualization of factory operations with KPIs and alerts

widgets.name: Throughput Monitor
widgets.description: Displays current throughput of the production line

widgets.name: Buffer Level Indicator
widgets.description: Shows real-time buffer levels across all buffers

thresholds.description: Buffer levels above 90% indicate potential bottleneck
Buffer levels above 95% indicate severe bottleneck
Machine availability below 80% indicates potential issues
Machine availability below 70% indicates significant downtime
Energy consumption per part above 15 kWh indicates inefficiency

throughput.name: Throughput
throughput.measurement_method: Count of parts processed per unit time

wip.name: Work in Progress
wip.measurement_method: Current buffer levels across all buffers

energy_consumption.name: Energy Consumption per Part
energy_consumption.measurement_method: Total energy consumed divided by number of parts produced

machine_availability.name: Machine Availability
machine_availability.measurement_method: Percentage of time machines are operational
